widgets_values:
基础调度器上的步数为总步数，分离sigmas上的为一采步数（不能低于6）总步数减去一采的步数就等于二采的步数（不要低于4），例如：总步数为12步，Sigmas填了8步，那8步就为一采步数，剩下4步就是二采的步数。总为10，Sigmas为6，那么一采为6步，二采为4步。傻逼都能懂！

PS: 一采最少6步，想要音质好一点就8步。
分辨率示例里的megapixels值是上面分辨率选择里的参考值，而不是二采倍数的参考值，二采倍数需要自己去计算，例如一采我选择0.5Mp--960X544的分辨率，二采倍数我填的1.5倍，那就是960X544的1.5倍就是1440X816。如果二采倍数我填2倍，那就是960X544的2倍就是1920X1088。傻逼都能懂！

subject_definitions:

<Subject 2> is a group of three large adult roosters whose breed and appearance come from <Picture 3>. Preserve the lead rooster’s body proportions, layered feather colors, bright-red comb, red wattles, legs, claws, and physically correct wings. The other two roosters share the same breed but remain individually distinguishable.

<Subject 3> is the 1990s Northeast China rural courtyard whose environment comes from <Picture 1>. Preserve its yellow-ochre mud walls, packed-earth ground with chicken footprints, weathered wooden elements, scattered broken bricks, fixed spatial layout, and strong left-side daylight producing hard ground shadows.

<Subject 4> is the sorghum-stalk broom from <Picture 1>, preserving its bundled dry stalks, wooden handle, rough natural texture, scale, weight, and flexible sweeping behavior.

summary:
[reference generation] The target is a 12-second, 16:9 cinematic high-fidelity 3D sequence. <Subject 1> confronts <Subject 2> inside <Subject 3>, instantly appears wearing a black iron pot as a helmet and wielding <Subject 4>, attacks with rapid uninterrupted broom sweeps, is chased toward screen right, trips over a broken brick, and falls. All action plays at normal playback speed with an approximately 1.25x brisk kinetic feel. Use four action shots connected only by immediate motion-matched hard cuts. No fades, cross-dissolves, generated captions, logos, or watermarks.

detailed_description:
The target uses cinematic high-fidelity 3D stylized realism with detailed skin and feathers, physically based materials, global illumination, volumetric sunlight, crisp contact shadows, realistic reflections, and restrained motion blur limited to broom tips and wing tips. All movement has an approximately 1.25x brisk real-time feel. No slow motion, speed ramps, easing, prolonged anticipation, recovery pauses, repeated action loops, or reaction delay longer than 0.15 seconds.

[Shot 1] A wide eye-level static shot establishes <Subject 3>. The lead member of <Subject 2> stands screen-left and takes two quick threatening steps toward <Subject 1> on screen-right. It performs one sudden forward feint. Within 0.15 seconds, the boy snaps his shoulders upward, clenches his fists, recoils half a step, and locks his gaze on the rooster. The confrontation lasts only 1.4 seconds. <Subject 4> remains visible against the right wall. Hard-cut on the rooster’s forward head thrust.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.400, the camera cuts to an eye-level 45-degree medium tracking shot. <Subject 1> already wears a black iron pot and grips <Subject 4> with both hands; omit the process of putting them on. He immediately executes four uninterrupted alternating horizontal sweeps toward screen-left, each taking 0.40–0.50 seconds with gaps shorter than 0.12 seconds and no reset pose. The camera tracks him with small amplitude at fast speed. <Subject 2> scatters with rapid wing beats while the lead rooster completes two fast jumping pecks. Dust and loose feathers react instantly. The final peck targets the boy’s lower leg, making him jerk backward, shout <d>[Chinese]啊——！</d>, and turn toward screen-right within 0.15 seconds.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, an action-matched hard cut changes to a 45-degree low medium-wide tracking view. <Subject 1> sprints toward screen-right for eleven short strides at approximately three steps per second, crossing more than half the courtyard rather than running in place. The iron pot rattles rapidly without falling, while <Subject 4> drags and bounces behind him. The lead rooster pursues from screen-left with six quick bounding steps and twice pecks the loose trouser cuff without injury. The camera tracks right at fast speed with brief handheld impacts. End with the boy’s left foot approaching the fixed broken brick.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.600, the camera hard-cuts closer and continues tracking right at fast speed. The boy takes three more rapid strides in 0.8 seconds. At 00:10.400, his left shoe strikes the broken brick; he loses balance within 0.15 seconds and completes one physically continuous forward fall in 0.45 seconds. His hands reach the ground first, his knees follow, <Subject 4> slides beneath his torso, and the iron pot rolls away approximately one and a half rotations only after impact. The camera stops instantly on the impact. The rooster pecks his shoe once, and the boy snaps his head back toward it within 0.15 seconds. Freeze only from 00:11.700 through 00:12.000.

overall_soundscape:
Maintain light rural wind and courtyard ambience beneath tightly synchronized rooster clucks, rapid wing beats, four broom swishes, fast footsteps, feather movement, dust scuffs, iron-pot rattling, one compact body-impact thud, and the pot rolling across packed earth. All action sounds stop instantly on the final freeze.

non_diegetic_music:
Use restrained accordion and harmonica over a crisp 128-BPM rhythmic pulse with short accented eighth notes. Increase rhythmic density during the chase without changing playback speed, then cut the music completely on the fall impact and keep the final freeze silent.
